metadata.title: Intermediate-Mass Black Holes in binary-rich star clusters

notes: No eligible stars. The paper is a theoretical N-body study of model star clusters and does not identify or analyze any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. Its discussion of HVSs/runaways (T:p9-b6) cites prior literature and does not explicitly establish any named star's present-day Galactic unbound status, while the generic "unbound HVS population" statements (T:p9-b4, T:p12-b6) do not identify individual members.
